Center City.name: Center City
Center City.description: The Campbell Avenue / Market Square CBD with office-to-residential conversions, the Roanoke STAR-adjacent civic projects, and the city's densest mixed-use pipeline.

Old Southwest.name: Old Southwest
Old Southwest.description: The turn-of-the-century streetcar suburb of brick rowhouses on the bluff southwest of downtown with steady restoration trades.

Hollins.name: Hollins
Hollins.description: The northwest Roanoke community around Hollins University with seasonal student-housing turnover and steady single-family reinvestment.

Mill Mountain.name: Mill Mountain
Mill Mountain.description: The south-side district at the base of Mill Mountain with cottage and bungalow stock, park-adjacent hospitality licensing, and hillside rebuild work.

Wasena.name: Wasena
Wasena.description: The Wasena neighborhood along the Roanoke River greenway with solid pre-war housing stock and investor renovation flow.

Vinton.name: Vinton
Vinton.description: The town of Vinton east of the Roanoke River with the lowest sale prices in the metro and steady vacancy-to-acquisition conversion flow.

Salem.name: Salem
Salem.description: The city of Salem west of Roanoke with the collegiate and medical-corridor rental register and block-by-block reinvestment.

Clearbrook.name: Clearbrook
Clearbrook.description: The rural-residential fringe southwest of Roanoke with acreage parcels, well-and-septic stock, and the slowest sale cadence in the metro.
